# Billiards Lounge

> Entertainment lounge in Edasherikadavu, Kizhuparamba, Kerala, India (673639). Online booking for Snooker, 8-Ball, Chess and PS5, plus a café.

Billiards Lounge is by the riverside of Edasserikadavu. Customers book a game by choosing an activity, date, duration, time slot and number of players, then confirm with their name and mobile number.

## Main pages

- [Home and online booking](https://www.billiardslounge.site/): Choose a game and reserve a table or session online
- [Sitemap](https://www.billiardslounge.site/sitemap.xml): List of indexable URLs
